overview_description.description:
Established in 2015, Snapbook is the MENA region’s leading and only full-fledged Internet photo publishing service, with customers from all over the world. With both mobile and web applications, Snapbook creates amazing photo books, high-resolution prints, unique mobile cases, and much more, making their products the ideal personalized gift.

Snapbook also offers customers services that are unique in the region, such as a fully realized pink service (an all-female production team), Cash on Delivery, and exclusive partnerships with regional delivery suppliers.
